item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a five-shot photo montage using ALL FIVE supplied reference images, in this exact order. 0-1 seconds: @dog, the golden retriever sitting in the park, subtle happy panting and gentle camera push-in. 1-2 seconds: @cat, surprised tabby on the gray sofa, slight ear movement and gentle push-in. 2-3 seconds: @friends, the two smiling adult friends at the beach, slight breeze and ocean waves. 3-4 seconds: @woman, adult woman portrait in the park, subtle natural smile and breeze in hair. 4-5 seconds: @lake, mountain lake landscape with softly rippling reflections, gentle cinematic push-in. Keep each reference as its own distinct shot, preserving the original subjects, facial identity, clothing, setting and photographic appearance. Use clean quick cuts between shots, not morphing people or animals into one another. Fit each original photograph attractively within widescreen framing without cutting off faces. Calm warm photo-album mood. No text, no added subjects, no speech.
